title: Jaxyn Lethe kick starts the year with an infectious New Single, “Can I See You Again?”
htmlContent:
Jaxyn Lethe is back with an exciting new single that might just be their best yet. “Can I See You Again?” is a fun, upbeat track that invites you to dance and feel good.

The driving rhythm gets you moving while Lethe’s smooth vocals shine over fresh sounds. The song captures a mix of longing and joy, creating an emotional and uplifting feeling. With its bright melodies, lively beats, and a catchy chorus that sticks in your head, “Can I See You Again?” is perfect for late-night drives, crowded dance floors, and endless replay.

https://open.spotify.com/album/15cR6fXm4MFrJ154yPgVyQ?si=ouREY7JyQm-0gK1SpslJeA

For Lethe, this release is about making a strong impression. Kicking off the year with such a powerful song shows their creativity and talent for making hits. If this is how they’re starting off, 2025 will be a big year for Jaxyn Lethe.
